title: 第一卷 第2章 洞天玉佩
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天刚蒙蒙亮，沈鹿溪就起了。

柳荞娘还在屋里缝衣裳，听见动静抬头：“鹿溪，你身子还没好利索，再歇歇。”

“娘，我没事了，想上山转转。”

柳荞娘张了张嘴，想拦又没拦住，这孩子从昨天醒来以后就不太一样。

话少了，眼神却亮了，做什么事都有股子劲头。

沈鹿溪从墙角翻出一个破竹筐，又找了一把柴刀别在腰间。

竹筐底有个洞，她拿稻草堵了堵，勉强能用。

沈小满蹲在门口洗脸，凉水泼在脸上，冻得他直吸气。

他看见姐姐背着筐出来，赶紧擦了把脸追上去：“姐，我跟你去。”

“你在家看着娘，别让她干重活。”

“可是……”

“听话。”沈鹿溪摸了摸他的脑袋，“姐中午回来给你带好东西。”

沈小满眼睛一亮：“什么好东西？”

“回来就知道了。”

沈鹿溪背着竹筐出了院门。

刚走到院子外头，就跟正房里出来的沈金宝撞了个对面。

沈金宝十六岁，长得五大三粗，一脸横肉，眼皮子耷拉着，嘴角还挂着昨晚吃的油渣。

他上下打量了沈鹿溪一眼，嗤笑一声：“哟，病秧子还没死呢？背着筐子干嘛去，捡破烂啊？”

沈鹿溪脚步没停，从他身边走过去。

沈金宝却不乐意了：“我跟你说话呢，你耳朵塞驴毛了？”

沈鹿溪头也没回，声音不大不小刚好够院子里的人听见：“金宝哥，你昨儿个在镇上赌钱输了多少，要不要我帮你算算？”

沈金宝的脸一下子就白了。

他赌钱的事瞒着家里，尤其瞒着王桂花。这要是传到老太太耳朵里，他得被拐棍敲一顿。

“你胡说什么！”他压低声音，脸上那股嚣张劲儿瞬间没了。

沈鹿溪这才回头看了他一眼，弯了弯嘴角，没再说话，转身出了院门。

沈金宝站在原地，脸色变了又变，愣是没敢追上去。

前世她不知道沈金宝赌钱的事，是后来逃难路上才听别人提起的。

那时候沈金宝已经欠了一屁股赌债，债主追上门，王桂花拿二房的卖女钱去填了窟窿。

这辈子，这些事她记得清清楚楚。

什么时候用，怎么用，她心里都有数。

出了村子，沿着田埂往北走，走上一刻钟就到了山脚。

青川县靠山，村后这座山叫老虎岭，名字吓人，其实没老虎，就是山势陡了些。

村里人平时上山砍柴打猎，走的都是山脚那条老路，很少往深处去。

沈鹿溪没走老路。

她顺着一条快被野草盖住的小径往山腰上爬。

这条路前世她走过，是跟外公上山打猎时发现的，能通到山腰一片背风的坡地。

Page (1/3)

As soon as it gets bright, Shenlu Creek rises.

Liu Qiao Niang was still sewing clothes in the house. When she heard the movement, she raised her head and said, "Lu Xi, you are not feeling well yet. Please take a rest."

"Mom, I'm fine. I want to go up the mountain for a walk."

Liu Qiaoniang opened her mouth, but tried to stop her but failed. This child has been different since she woke up yesterday.

He talks less, but his eyes are brighter, and he is full of energy in everything he does.

Shen Luxi dug out a broken bamboo basket from the corner of the wall, then found a hatchet and stuck it on his waist.

There was a hole in the bottom of the bamboo basket, and she blocked it with straw, but it was barely usable.

Shen Xiaoman squatted at the door and washed his face. Cold water was splashed on his face, making him gasp for air from the cold.

When he saw his sister coming out with a basket on her back, he quickly wiped his face and chased after her: "Sister, I'll go with you."

"You watch your mother at home and don't let her do heavy work."

"But..."

"Be obedient." Shen Luxi touched his head, "Sister, I'll bring you something when you come back at noon."

Shen Xiaoman's eyes lit up: "What good thing?"

"We'll find out when we get back."

Shen Luxi walked out of the courtyard carrying a bamboo basket.

As soon as he walked outside the yard, he bumped into Shen Jinbao who was coming out of the main room.

Shen Jinbao is sixteen years old, tall and thick-set, with a rough face, droopy eyelids, and the leftover residue from last night's meal hanging from the corner of his mouth.

He looked Shen Luxi up and down and sneered: "Hey, the sick man is not dead yet? Why are you carrying a basket and picking up rags?"

Shen Luxi walked past him without stopping.

Shen Jinbao was not happy: "I'm talking to you, are you wearing donkey hair in your ears?"

Shen Luxi didn't even turn around. His voice was neither loud nor quiet, just enough for people in the yard to hear: "Brother Jinbao, how much money did you lose gambling in town yesterday? Do you want me to help you figure it out?"

Shen Jinbao's face suddenly turned pale.

He hid his gambling from his family, especially from Wang Guihua.If this got to the old lady's ears, he would be beaten with a cane.

"What nonsense are you talking about!" He lowered his voice, and the arrogance on his face disappeared instantly.

Shen Luxi then looked back at him, curled his lips, said no more, turned around and walked out of the courtyard.

Shen Jinbao stood there, his face changing again and again, but he didn't dare to catch up.

She didn't know about Shen Jinbao's gambling in her previous life. She only heard it mentioned by others on the way to escape.

At that time, Shen Jinbao already owed a lot of gambling debts, and the creditors came after him. Wang Guihua used the money from the sale of his second wife's daughter to fill the hole.

In this life, she remembered these things clearly.

She knew when to use it and how to use it.

After leaving the village, we walked north along the field ridge and reached the foot of the mountain in a quarter of an hour.

The mountain behind Qingchuan County is called Laohuling. The name is scary. In fact, there are no tigers, but the mountain is steeper.

The villagers usually go up the mountain to cut firewood and hunt. They always take the old road at the foot of the mountain and rarely go deep.

Shen Luxi did not follow the old path.

She climbed up the mountainside along a path that was almost covered with weeds.

She had walked this road in her previous life and discovered it when she and her grandfather went hunting in the mountains. It led to a leeward slope on the mountainside.
